description:
STEP 1 sub-phase (build beside the old). GATES the contract.rs collapse (Step 3). Code-review finding 4.

The contract.rs collapse is NOT a freebie: the existing calculator (key_subsumes_with / collect_instantiation_subst) is boolean and first-binding-wins. contract.rs needs five behaviors with no calculator equivalent today. Grow them on the calculator (memoized Types methods, per feedback_types_is_the_calculator), additively, beside the boolean API:

1. Known / Underconstrained / Invalid TRICHOTOMY (not a bool). Underconstrained = a witness left some addressed leaf free (e.g. foo(x,y,z) vs foo(a,{b,c},d): y subsumes the interned {a1_0,a1_1}, binds the tuple, leaves a1_0/a1_1 free -> Underconstrained). The verdict is "did the witness ground every addressed leaf."
2. Union-on-rebind when a var binds multiple witnesses (merge_sigma semantics), vs or_insert first-binding-wins.
3. Structural-mismatch -> Invalid for arrow-arity.
4. Same for map-key-presence and tuple-arity.
5. Ambiguous empty-list var handling (collect_ambiguous_empty_list_vars equivalent).

These are additive calculator tickets that MUST land before any contract.rs trigger is removed.

Depends on: addressed-arrow machinery (fz-hwn.27.2).
Checks: calculator unit tests for each of the 5 behaviors against interned addressed arrows; consistent-Sigma keyed (feedback_single_concretetypes_instance: one ConcreteTypes/Types instance threaded, never re-inlined); lib green, zero warnings.

comments.text: Refined boundary (no-duplication, verified vs HEAD): warnings-are-errors forbids leaving a dead duplicate 'beside' the trash_ engine. So 27.4 RELOCATES the trichotomy/substitution engine OUT of contract.rs (deletes the trash_ free-fns: trash_collect_*_subst, trash_instantiate_match, trash_overlapping_witnesses, trash_contract_witness, trash_surface_sigma, trash_merge_sigma, trash_instantiated_match, trash_collect_ambiguous_empty_list_vars, trash_is_exact_empty_list, TrashWitness, TrashSchemeMatch/Instantiation enums) INTO a Types submodule (types/arrow_match.rs) as the calculator, exposing Types::match_arrow -> ArrowMatch{Known|Underconstrained|Invalid}. contract.rs::apply calls it. The trash_ SURFACE TYPES (TrashContractArrow/TrashAppliedContractArrow) REMAIN until 27.9 (their restructure needs the arrow re-key). Direct calculator unit tests cover the 5 behaviors. contract_test.rs stays green = behavior-preserving move.

title: Extend the Types calculator: trichotomy, union-rebind, structural-mismatch, map/tuple arity, empty-list
